type_1.name: Type I - Single Feature Rule
type_1.description: Category A: All circles, Category B: All triangles

type_2.name: Type II - XOR Rule
type_2.description: Category A: (Small circles OR Large triangles), Category B: (Large circles OR Small triangles)
type_2.rule: (shape == 0 AND size == 0) OR (shape == 1 AND size == 1) → A

type_6.name: Type VI - Family Resemblance
type_6.description: No simple rule - category determined by overall similarity
type_6.rule: No explicit rule - family resemblance structure
